product_id.description:
Coolblue product number (Artikelnummer), the number after /product/ in its URL.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 999999999.

url.description: HTTPS coolblue.nl product URL. Supply this or product_id. Pattern: ^https://(?:www\.)?coolblue\.nl/(?:en/)?product/[0-9]+(?:[/?#]|$).

cons: De kabel werkt alleen vanuit een usb C aansluiting op je laptop of desktop naar DisplayPort, en niet van een DisplayPort poort op je pc naar usb C.
value.description: Met deze BlueBuilt USB-C naar DisplayPort Kabel 2m sluit je gemakkelijk jouw laptop of pc met usb C ingang aan op de DisplayPort ingang van je monitor of televisie. Met een DisplayPort kabel verzend je beelden en geluiden van hogere kwaliteit dan met een usb kabel. Dit maakt deze kabel bijvoorbeeld geschikt voor gaming. Door de kabellengte van 2 meter heb je hier ook genoeg ruimte voor. De DisplayPort heeft een 1.4 connector, waardoor hij genoeg bandbreedte heeft voor een 4K ultra HD stream tot 120 hertz. Bij dit BlueBuilt product krijg je 5 jaar garantie.
value.name: BlueBuilt USB-C naar DisplayPort Kabel 2m
pros: Sluit je laptop of pc met usb C ingang aan op een DisplayPort ingang op jouw monitor of televisie.
Door de kabellengte van 2 meter heb je genoeg ruimte tussen je apparaten.
Bij dit BlueBuilt product krijg je 5 jaar garantie.

200.description:
Get a Coolblue.nl product by product number or URL: name, brand, EUR price and list price, stock state and delivery promise, rating (1-10) and review count, key specs, the full specification table, EAN when published, and pros and cons when published.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `cons` | string[] | Minus points (Minpunten) as published; null when the page has none. |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `delivery_promise` | string | Delivery/stock promise in the order block, in Dutch, e.g. 'Op voorraad' or 'Bezorgd op donderdag'. Reflects the default (no postal code) promise. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `ean` | string | EAN/GTIN when Coolblue publishes it (JSON-LD or a specification row); Coolblue usually does not, so this is mostly null. |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `in_stock` | boolean | stock_status is OnStock. |
| `key_specs` | string[] | Coolblue's short highlight specs for the product (may be empty). |
| `list_price` | number | Struck-through reference price (Adviesprijs) in EUR when it is above the selling price, else null. |
| `manufacturer_code` | string | Manufacturer part number (Fabrikantcode). |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `price` | number | Selling price in EUR including VAT. |
| `product_id` | number |  |
| `product_type` | string | Coolblue product type, singular, in Dutch (e.g. laptop). |
| `pros` | string[] | Plus points (Pluspunten) as published; null when the page has none. |
| `rating` | number | Average customer score on Coolblue's 1-10 scale; null without reviews. |
| `review_count` | number |  |
| `specifications` | object[] | Full specification table grouped as on the page (Dutch labels). |
| `stock_status` | string | Coolblue availability state, e.g. OnStock, BackOrder, TemporaryOutOfStock, OutOfStock. |
| `url` | string |  |

200.description:
Search Coolblue.nl by keyword and return one page of products: product id, name, EUR price and list price, rating (1-10) and review count, stock state, delivery text and URL, plus the input for the next page. Curated keywords that Coolblue redirects to a category return that category's listing.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `has_more` | boolean |  |
| `next_page_input` | object | Input for the next page of this search, or null on the last page. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `redirected_to` | string | Category path Coolblue redirects this keyword to (e.g. /mobiele-telefoons/smartphones/apple-iphone); results then come from that category listing. Null for a plain search. |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `total_pages` | number |  |
| `url` | string | The listing URL that was read: the /zoeken search page, or the category listing Coolblue redirected the keyword to. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
